historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission let the Merced Heights Improvement Association put a bronze plaque on the new field house at the playground, then called Byxbee Playground, as part of its dedication; the Commission's index records the playground dedicated on April 8, 1951.
The Recreation Commission awarded the contract to build the field house at Byxbee Playground, at Byxbee and Shields Streets, to H. L. Petersen Construction Company at $21,672, the lowest of six bids.

At the request of the district's residents, the Recreation Commission resolved that the playground under construction at Byxbee and Shields Streets be dedicated and named Merced Heights Playground on its completion.
